sentences.text: 1 The petitioner before this Court is seeking an anticipatory bail, which was declined by the High Court by an order dated 19.04.2024.
The petitioner is an accused for the offences punishable under Sections 304B and 498A read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 and 4 of the Domestic Violence Act.
Vide order dated 05.11.2024, interim protection was granted to the petitioner, subject to cooperation in the investigation.
Considering the entire facts of the case, we do not think that this is a case where custodial interrogation of the petitioner is required.
Hence, we are of the opinion that the petitioner is entitled for an anticipatory bail.
The petitioner shall respond to the Investigating Officer and shall visit the Police Station as and when she is required.
However, under the circumstances, we are of the opinion that the petitioner is entitled for an anticipatory bail.

In the event of arrest of the petitioner in connection with FIR No. 1166 of 2023 registered at Harishchandrapur Police Station, she shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds with two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting officer.
In view of above, the Special leave Petition is disposed of.

Pending interlocutory application(s)
is/are disposed of.

(JAYANT KUMAR ARORA) (RENU BALA GAMBHIR)
